column1: # These owners are built outside the firmware target and are repackaged from
# their immutable r2 artifacts into r3.  They are nevertheless peers of every
# target-derived runtime in the r3 closure, not application-bundled blobs.
# Audacious 4.6.1 is built once by the audited core recipe. Its three public
# libraries have one reusable runtime owner; the player and every loadable
# Audacious plugin acquire that owner through exact dependencies instead of
# copying any of these SONAMEs into their payload.
# Archive utilities add three public compression-library SONAMEs that do not
# exist in the immutable r9 firmware target. Each SONAME has one independently
# installable IPK owner; archive applications depend on them instead of copying
# a private library into a command package.
# Python's libpython is public ABI for native extension modules and therefore
# is split from the standard library data and the interpreter executable.
